const comparisonArray: number[] = [];
console.log(comparisonArray === ([] as number[]), ([]) === comparisonArray, comparisonArray === <number[]>[], comparisonArray === [1]!);
const comparisonObject = {a: 1};
console.log(comparisonObject == ({a: 1}), comparisonObject !== ({a:1} as {a:number}));
const comparisonNaN=Number("not a number");
console.log(comparisonNaN === (NaN as number), comparisonNaN === NaN!, comparisonNaN === <number>NaN, comparisonNaN === Number.NaN, comparisonNaN === -NaN);
